summary: A note from the University of Illinois on making mathematical software libraries available over the ARPANET. It lists projects such as the Bell Labs library, IMSL and NATS, and suggests that the network could make such libraries shareable resources. It discusses what stands in the way.

eli5.summary: Many places had collections of ready-made math tools. This note says the network could let everyone borrow them instead of building their own.

questions: sharing math libraries over a network
